# signoz_log_pipeline (Resource)

Creates and manages log pipeline resources in SigNoz.

**Note:** The SigNoz log pipeline API uses a batch-replace pattern. All pipelines are submitted as a single array. This resource manages individual pipelines by reading the full array, modifying the target pipeline, and writing the full array back.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

resource "signoz_log_pipeline" "extract_severity" {
  name        = "Extract Severity"
  alias       = "extract-severity"
  description = "Extract severity from log body"
  enabled     = true
  order_id    = 1

  filter = jsonencode({
    op = "AND"
    items = [
      {
        key = {
          key  = "service_name"
          type = "tag"
        }
        op    = "="
        value = "api-server"
      }
    ]
  })

  config = jsonencode([
    {
      id         = "proc-1"
      orderId    = 1
      enabled    = true
      name       = "Extract severity"
      type       = "grok_parser"
      output     = "severity"
      parse_from = "body"
      pattern    = "%{WORD:severity}"
    }
  ])
}

output "log_pipeline" {
  value = signoz_log_pipeline.extract_severity
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the log pipeline.
- `order_id` (Number) Order ID of the log pipeline, determining processing order.
- `filter` (String) Filter configuration for the log pipeline as a JSON string.
- `config` (String) Processor configuration for the log pipeline as a JSON array string.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Alias identifier for the log pipeline.
- `description` (String) Description of the log pipeline.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the log pipeline is enabled. Defaults to true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Autogenerated unique ID for the log pipeline.
- `created_by` (String) User who created the log pipeline.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the log pipeline was created.

## Import

Import is supported using the pipeline ID:

```shell
terraform import signoz_log_pipeline.example pipeline-abc-123
```
